intro.label: The people behind the trails
intro.heading: Our
intro.body:
As pioneers in Nepali tourism, we have felt the pulse and rhythm of the country with every virgin trail we've walked, every nook and cranny we've traversed, and every new face that has smiled at us. We know every bump on the road, every bloodstain in our history and the slightest gesture in our culture. Believe us when we say that we single-handedly bring more to the table than the entire travel industry set up in Thamel.

Joyful Trekking Pvt. Ltd.: A child was growing up, observing and enjoying the geographical variation and the beauty it produced. Since childhood, he has enjoyed the chirps of birds, the howling of jackals, the gurgling of rivers, and the Himalayas playing hide-and-seek with clouds, and trees staying bare, sometimes, then again, bearing new leaves and fruits of their kind. Besides, he observed and participated in cultural programs celebrated in his multi-ethnic communities. His upbringing taught him to love nature and respect culture.
